# TASK-015 Report job cadence

Status: ready

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence the business wants.

## Notes

- Issue #31 (opened in May) says: "make the report job run weekly".
- The current value is in src/report_job.js.

## Decision (2026-10-21)

- Cadence: `daily`, not `weekly`. Issue #31 (May) is stale: ADR 0002 (weekly) was superseded by 0014, which 0023 superseded in turn.
- Governing ruling: mira-decisions ADR 0023 "Reports go out daily at 07:00" (Accepted), read at mira-decisions commit 1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c. It says the report job runs every day at 07:00 shop time.
- Implementation (not done here): change `SCHEDULE` in `src/report_job.js` from `'weekly'` to `'daily'`, and drop the "see issue #31" comment. The 07:00 time of day is also in ADR 0023.
- Mira asked for this to be done today. That did not change the choice, because an Accepted ruling already covers it.
